app.title: v2.0.6?? SO FAST GOATED RIGHT??
app.message:
What's new?

• Added default player preferences (Sub/Dub, Quality, Audio)
  Because selecting the same settings every episode builds character, but gets annoying after episode 847.

• Added subtitle padding
  For those who enjoy reading subtitles without them cuddling the edge of the screen.

• Fixed subtitle outline/stroke
  Subtitles should now be visible instead of playing hide-and-seek with bright scenes.

If something breaks, it's a bug.
If nothing breaks, I'm just as surprised as you are.
